message.content:
An editorial magazine cover features a vertical red banner on the left and a large white "TEMPO" title across the top. Centered is an illustration of a man with light skin, grey hair, and spectacles, wearing a black and red judicial robe over a white collared shirt and black belt. His right hand pulls back his robe to reveal several small wooden gavels hanging from the interior lining. Each gavel has a white tag with a barcode attached to its handle. His left hand rests on his hip.

Large black text to the left of the man reads "WANI PIRO?" Above this, smaller text reads "EDISI 7-13 OKTOBER 2013." Below the main heading, smaller black and red text states, "Dituding mengatur sengketa pilkada, jaringan Akil Mochtar tersebar di DPR dan kantor pengacara." At the very top, two headlines in white read "SIAPA PEMBUNUH ISTRI GELAP PEJABAT BPK" and "BAU ANYIR KASUS SUDJIONO TIMAN." A barcode, price "RP 33.000," and website "WWW.TEMPO.CO" are located in the bottom-left corner.
